mapper.select: /* PlatformLocationMapper.selectRecentPlatformSmsSendCnt */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S WHERE 1=1 AND S.MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.SEND_STATUS <> 'FAILED' AND S.INSERT_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)

/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectPlatformCertSmsId */ SELECT S.SMS_ID FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S WHERE 1=1 AND S.MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND S.AUTH_CD = #{certNo} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.EXPIRED_AT >= NOW() AND S.VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND S.FAIL_CNT < 5 ORDER BY S.SMS_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* PlatformLocationMapper.increasePlatformSmsFailCnt */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET FAIL_CNT = FAIL_CNT + 1 WHERE 1=1 AND MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SMS_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select:
/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectPlatformSmsVerified */ SELECT S.SMS_ID AS smsId
, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(S.UPDATE_DATE, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS verifiedAt , TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), DATE_ADD(S.UPDATE_DATE, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS remainSec FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.MBL_NO_HMAC = S.MBL_NO_HMAC WHERE 1=1 AND U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND S.UPDATE_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY S.UPDATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectLocationSiteList */ SELECT S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NO AS siteNo , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , S.LAT AS lat , S.LON AS lon , S.GPS_RANGE AS gpsRange FROM TB_SITE S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY S.SITE_CD ASC
